senses.def: The paramount traditional ruler of the Berom kingdom.

ex: Facing the door which leads into the compound itself is, let us say, a figure, male or female, which is a gbo or charm acting as a guardian of the entrance. The type of gbo differs, but some guardian of the entrance ther
He is a Gbokanto, one who makes gbos or magical items. The Aziza, the little monkeys or humanoids who live in the forest and give magic to man are his creatures.
